doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tape two: how he got the name Snooky
summary: On tape two Young explains that an aunt called him Snooks and that Snooky Young stuck as his professional name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Ok, this is tape two of the Smithsonian NEA Jazz Oral History interview with Snooky Young. Well, we talked about, you talked about Diz, you knew Diz before he was Diz, or known as Diz. But we didn‘t talk about how you got your name, Snooky.
How did you get your name Snooky?

I got my name when I was a little baby, I don‘t know how I got my name Snooky. I haven‘t the slightest idea, one of my aunts started calling me ―Snooks.‖ And as time went on it stayed Snooks, finally it got, I don‘t know when it went to Snooky, but it finally went to Snooky. But I haven‘t the slightest idea; I think it was an aunt who named me Snooks and it went on. They used to like me and when I was a little kid, my aunts, a couple of them, really liked me as a little kid.
I‘m wondering, since you were a junior, they couldn‘t call you Eugene or Edward, because that‘s your father‘s name. And maybe, I don‘t know, I‘m just, I don‘t know…

Well they called me, when I first went in school, they called me Eugene. But that didn‘t last long – Eugene Edward Young. Well I think I was called ―junior,‖ not in school, but at home sometimes. Junior they would call me. But that didn‘t last long. I can‘t tell but I do remember being called Junior, some.
[laughs] Okay, but your professional name ―Snooky,‖ that‘s what you, that‘s what you stuck with, ―Snooky Young,‖ your professional name.

Well, after I got, uh…Snooky Young, that got to be, after I got in…uh, got out of Chick Carter‘s Band and different bands and things, Snooky Young, this went together. You know, Snooky Young, they didn‘t just say Snooky, they said Snooky Young. So it kind of went together, that‘s how I got to be Snooky Young, I think.
